metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Readers are analysis-only, fit on the fresh training pool, tuned on the fixed canonical VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST. The ONLY experimental factor is N_train; optimizer updates are 200 at every scale. No TEST-based selection.

primary_decision.rule_note: W-A if some reader at L4/full has top-scale test>=0.50 AND held-out>=0.30 AND gain_full>=0.15; W-B if best top-scale test<=0.25 AND held-out<=0.25 AND Bayes-reader>=0.30 AND every gain_full<0.15; W-C if a material gain (>=0.15) or an intermediate best top-scale test (>0.25) without W-A; W-MIX on E/F or reader contradiction.
